name: fantasy-hub
status_detail: Multi-league fantasy football tools. Every tool lives under /l/[leagueId] with leagues auto-discovered from Sleeper and format detected from settings.type. Two live leagues: Dah Dynasty League (dynasty, in season) and 2026 Half PPR (redraft, pre-draft). Values, player pages, season goals, and resources all split by league format. Written playbooks with sources at /strategy. Jingles Labs curated in as a redraft annotation layer.
next_steps: Pull in new Jingles Labs posts as he publishes (see docs/refreshing-jingles.md); the Lab 300 is announced but unshipped
Redraft-specific draft board: ADP tiers and roster construction, before the 2026 Half PPR draft (not yet scheduled)
Find a real ADP source; FantasyCalc redraft caps at 200 players and has no DEF
Connect a guillotine league when joined: declare it in src/lib/league/manual.ts, then wire weekly scores
Wire 2026 NFL schedule into survivor future-scarcity grid
Integrate Vegas lines via the-odds-api before Week 1
blockers: Guillotine league not joined and host platform unknown. Strategy rules and playbook are built and verified, but no live data source exists
FantasyCalc redraft returns only 200 players (dynasty returns 475), limit param ignored, and no DEF. Thin for a 14-round draft in a league that starts a DEF
notes: 2026-08-15: Split rankings and resources by format. Player pages had contradicted themselves, showing RosterAudit dynasty tiers and a KeepTradeCut cross-check under a 'Redraft values' label; those are now dynasty-only and the headline value/rank/trend follow the format's source. Resources tagged and filterable (51 dynasty, 39 redraft, 26 guillotine), with 30 researched redraft entries, all URLs verified. Corrected how Jingles Labs is described: he posts high/low-vs-ADP calls and league-winner deep dives, not rankings. Added his James Cook deep dive and a 'pulled <date>' staleness marker.

2026-08-14: Phase 2 shipped. season-plan split into src/lib/strategy with per-format rule sets; playoff berths and season length now read from league settings. New /strategy page carries researched playbooks for all three formats with 12 external sources. Guillotine numbers sourced from Fantasy Life, RotoWire, DraftSharks, Fantasy Index, Footballguys. Verified guillotine rules via a temporary route across September-danger and December-endgame states, which caught three contradictions in the endgame goals.

2026-08-14: Phase 1 multi-league shipped. Routes moved from /dynasty to /l/[leagueId] with permanent redirects, league switcher in the header, nav renders only format-appropriate tools. Values now format-aware: 87 of 200 shared players move 20+ ranks between dynasty and redraft. Jingles Labs added (21 calls, 30 tiered backup RBs). Design spec at docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-14-multi-league-design.md.
2026-08-14: Renamed Dynasty Hub to Fantasy Hub across code, GitHub repo, Vercel project, and local folder. Live at fantasy-hub-tan.vercel.app; dynasty-hub-nine.vercel.app still resolves.
2026-05-17: Dashboard registration. Last work was survivor Phase 1 (pool config, team matrix, baseline ratings, strategy library) committed 2026-05-10.
